signals.title: AccountingInvoiceManagementPage: create/delete mutations have no onError — silent invoice failures
evidence: AccountingInvoiceManagementPage.tsx:36-42 — createMutation (invoicesApiCreate) has only onSuccess; no onError, component never reads isError. Failed create leaves form open with no feedback (isPending flips back, setIsCreating stays true).

AccountingInvoiceManagementPage.tsx:44-49,88-91 — deleteMutation is likewise onSuccess-only. Failed delete is silent (no toast/alert/isError branch); list only invalidated on success so row stays and user believes nothing happened.
This is the sole page in the ppt-web-ui segment whose write mutations surface no error state (sibling pages read isError + render role=alert blocks).
Impact: medium — financial write paths (issue / delete invoice) where silent failure lets a manager believe an invoice was created or removed when it was not.

signals.title: ppt-web: 103 hardcoded English aria-label attributes across feature components — screen readers hear English on sk/cs/de
evidence: 103 hardcoded English aria-label attributes across ppt-web feature components are not wrapped in react-i18next t(...) — screen-reader users on sk/cs/de locales hear English accessibility labels even though visible copy is translated. grep pattern used: `grep -rn 'aria-label="[A-Z]' frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features --include='*.tsx' | grep -v 't('` => 103 hits.

signals.title: SessionsPage double-casts through unknown to hand-maintained interface — defeats API-boundary type-check
evidence: SessionsPage.tsx:84 — `const sessions = (sessionsQuery.data?.sessions ?? []) as unknown as SessionRow[];` double-casts generated-client response through `unknown` into a local SessionRow interface (:22, 'mirrors the backend SessionInfo DTO'). If backend DTO drifts (isCurrent → is_current, etc.), compile does not catch it; `sessions.some((s) => !s.isCurrent)` silently reads undefined.
Only `as unknown as` boundary cast in the segment. Fix: consume generated client's Session type directly.
Impact: low — no current runtime bug, but the cast removes the compile-time guard on a security-relevant page (active-session list / revoke).

evidence: queryKeys.ts:347 AUTHED_QUERY_KEY_ROOTS is the allow-list logout() iterates to purge session-scoped TanStack Query subtrees (AuthContext.tsx:553-555). Feature roots not in this list are NOT purged on logout.

Three feature-local *Keys factories define roots absent from AUTHED_QUERY_KEY_ROOTS: predictive-maintenance (`['predictive-maintenance']`), sentiment (`['sentiment']`), notification-analytics (`['notification-analytics']`). Only `ai-chat` from that batch is present.

All three are routed and tenant-scoped (routes/lazyRoutes.tsx:317/322/336). ppt-web is an SPA; logout does not reload — user B on a shared workstation sees user A's cached data until staleTime (5m) lapses.
Fix: add the three roots to AUTHED_QUERY_KEY_ROOTS + add a unit/lint assertion that every feature-local *Keys.all is a member so future gap-sweep pages can't reintroduce the leak.

evidence: App.tsx:229-231 — the entire lazy route table renders inside `<main><Suspense fallback={<RouteLoading/>}><AppRoutes/></Suspense></main>` with NO React error boundary at the route-outlet level. The ONLY ErrorBoundary is at the root (main.tsx:50).

routes/lazyRoutes.tsx defines ~90 `lazy(() => import(...))` chunks. A rejected dynamic import is not caught by Suspense — it propagates as a thrown error. Post-redeploy, a user holding a stale index.html requesting an old hashed chunk (404) crashes the entire tree to the root boundary's blank fallback.
Fix: wrap `<AppRoutes/>` in a per-outlet `<ErrorBoundary>` that catches import failures and prompts a full reload, keeping the rest of the shell mounted.

evidence: rentals.tsx four useMutation hooks omit onError: createConnection (:258), syncPlatforms (:272), checkIn (:373), checkOut (:385). Each defines only onSuccess (invalidateQueries).
financial.tsx PaymentManagementPageRoute: matchMutation (:296 manual payment→invoice allocation) and autoMatchMutation (:305 bulk auto-match) also lack onError.

Same pattern the recently-merged PR #2631 fixed for AccountingInvoiceManagementPage. Backend failure on any of these six writes surfaces nothing to the user (no toast, no isError branch). Financial paths (payment matching) and Airbnb-platform sync are the highest-risk sites.
Fix: wire onError → parseApiError → showToast on all six, mirroring the pattern PR #2631 established for the invoice page.

evidence: rentals.tsx:169-176 useRentalsAuth() returns `{ authorization, xTenantId } | null` and returns null when `!token || !user?.organizationId` (e.g. access token expired / cleared mid-session).

useQuery call sites guard correctly with `enabled: !!auth`. But useMutation has no `enabled` gate: createConnection/syncPlatforms/checkIn/checkOut all dereference `auth!.authorization` — non-null assertion in the mutationFn.

If auth transitions to null between page mount and mutation invocation, the click throws `TypeError: cannot read properties of null` inside the mutation callback → uncaught, crashes to the app-root ErrorBoundary (see route-error-boundary-gap sibling finding). User sees blank screen instead of a re-auth prompt.
Fix: gate mutations behind `!!auth` (disabled state on the trigger button) or return early with a re-auth prompt from the mutationFn; drop the non-null assertion.
signals.title: ppt-web rentals mutations non-null-assert useRentalsAuth() — mid-session token loss causes hard client crash instead of prompt-to-reauth

evidence: Eight route-wrapper 'entity not found' fallbacks render hardcoded English JSX with no react-i18next `t(...)`: announcements.tsx:521 & :596, buildings.tsx:36, community.tsx:78, and five siblings in the same file cluster.

User-facing strings on a real render path (returned when a detail route id resolves to no entity). Slovak/Czech/German user hitting a missing/deleted entity sees English. Same lens as the reality-web ProtectedRoute i18n finding just merged in PR #2633.
Fix: convert to `t('common.notFound.<entity>')` with entries in all six locale bundles (en/sk/cs/de/pl/hu) — mirrors the shared `common.notFound.*` namespace convention now standard in ppt-web.

evidence: useOfflineSupport.ts:360-375 — on a *retryable* failure the FIFO drain intentionally halts: it sets haltedProgress { current: i+1, failed, isComplete: <true if last>, halted: true } and returns. The UI reads `isComplete` as the terminal signal.

Consumers observing `isComplete: true` reasonably assume the queue was drained; halted state (which still has queued actions waiting for the failed head to unblock) is indistinguishable from a real full drain.
Fix: only set isComplete when the queue is actually empty at the tail of drain; otherwise expose { halted: true } distinctly. Sync-status indicators otherwise show 'all synced' during a stuck queue.

evidence: ThreadDetailScreen.tsx:139-142,152-163 — sendMessage (useApiMutation POST /api/v1/messages/threads/{id}/messages) is invoked via sendMessage.mutate(...) with an onSuccess callback but NO onError. Failed sends leave the composed text cleared (setInput('')) and produce no toast/alert.
Same finding-class as ppt-web PR #2631 fixed for invoice pages. Users on flaky mobile networks lose their composed message on a network error with zero feedback.
Fix: attach onError → parseApiError → Alert.alert / showToast; consider restoring the input on failure so the user can retry.

evidence: useOfflineSupport.ts:353-357 — catch branch increments action.retries then `if (isPermanent || action.retries >= 3)` adds the action to the terminally-failed set and drops it. Only side effect: console.error.

Offline-created content (report-fault drafts, thread messages composed offline, community posts) that trips a transient 5xx/network on all 3 in-app retries is silently DELETED from the queue with no user-visible signal. No sentry/error-tracking hook, no user notification.
Fix: surface terminal drops to the user (persistent notification / retry-drawer / sentry breadcrumb); consider bumping to exponential-backoff-with-cap semantics instead of hard 3-strikes.
